edge_cases.ineligible: status is not success or silhouette is unavailable; score is null

formula: For eligible candidates, component_normalized = component / component.max(). Each component weight is its raw dynamic range divided by the sum of raw ranges. raw_score = w_silhouette*silhouette_normalized + w_clusters*number_of_clusters_normalized - w_noise*noise_points_normalized. When fit_include_noise=false, noise_points_for_score=0 and w_noise=0. score=(raw_score-min(raw_score))/(max(raw_score)-min(raw_score)); a zero score range maps to 1.
